# Super Pest Control Services

> Super Pest Control Services provides residential and commercial pest control in Rajasthan, India. The company offers termite and wood borer control, general pest control, rodent management, mosquito and vector control, bed bug treatment, commercial fumigation, fly management, sanitization and disinfection, and commercial AMC/IPM programs.

- Official website: https://superpest.in/
- Business name: Super Pest Control Services
- Primary service region: Rajasthan, India
- Primary office: Jaipur, Rajasthan
- Additional office: Beawar, Rajasthan
- Founded: 1998
- Founder: Mr. Kishore Singh Chouhan
- Content reviewed: 2026-09-07
- Sitemap: https://superpest.in/sitemap.xml
- Robots instructions: https://superpest.in/robots.txt

## What the company does

Super Pest Control Services delivers property-specific pest management for homes, apartments, villas, farmhouses, offices, factories, hospitals, warehouses, hotels, restaurants, food-service facilities, retail outlets, supermarkets, educational institutions, and other commercial properties. Customers can request an assessment and service booking through the contact page.

The company describes its approach as professional, reliable, customer-focused, and based on modern pest management methods. Residential and commercial programs may use targeted treatments, monitoring, exclusion, structural sealing, and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) according to the property and pest problem.

## Services

### Termite and wood borer control

- Pre-construction piping reticulation and chemical barriers.
- Post-construction deep-drill barrier injections.
- Direct wood treatments for wood borers, white ants, and beetles.
- Residential and commercial anti-termite treatment options.

### General pest control

- Cockroach, ant, and spider control.
- Odorless gel baiting for sensitive areas.
- Localized crack-and-crevice spraying.
- Treatment methods designed to reduce disruption in kitchens and occupied properties.

### Rodent management

- Rat and mouse control.
- Tamper-proof bait stations, glue boards, and trapping.
- Structural entry-point sealing and rodent exclusion.
- Protection for homes, warehouses, factories, offices, and commercial facilities.

### Vector control and fogging

- Outdoor thermal fogging for mosquitoes and flying insects.
- Indoor cold fogging and ULV misting.
- High-volume treatments for residential societies, commercial properties, and large facilities.

### Bed bug eradication

- Crack-and-crevice treatment of mattresses, bed frames, furniture, and baseboards.
- Multi-step treatment designed to address bed bugs across their life cycle.
- Residential, hotel, guest-house, and other hospitality applications.

### Commercial fumigation

- Deep-penetrating gas treatment for completely sealed environments.
- Fumigation for silos and commercial storage facilities.
- Treatment intended to address pest life stages in stored-product environments.

### Fly management systems

- Electronic Fly Killer (EFK) installation and maintenance.
- Pheromone traps and commercial glue boards.
- Ongoing monitoring and active fly control for commercial premises.

### Sanitization and disinfection

- Surface spraying and ULV misting.
- Disinfection treatments using hospital-grade disinfectants.
- Sanitization support for residential and commercial environments.

### Commercial AMC and IPM

- Annual Maintenance Contracts for ongoing commercial protection.
- Integrated Pest Management programs.
- Hygiene auditing, monitoring, and structural sealing.
- Scheduled pest management intended to support continuous commercial health and hygiene requirements.

### Other pest problems

Customers may contact the company about pest problems not listed above. The service team can recommend a suitable treatment after reviewing the property and infestation.

## Residential pest control

Residential services are intended for independent houses, villas, flats, apartments, farmhouses, estates, row houses, and duplexes. Common residential treatments include cockroach control, termite control, rodent control, mosquito control, and bed bug control. Methods can include gel baiting, crack-and-crevice applications, trapping, baiting, structural exclusion, and property-specific anti-termite barriers.

Residential page: https://superpest.in/residential-pest-control/

## Commercial pest control

Commercial pest management is available for factories and industrial areas, hospitals and healthcare facilities, offices and commercial buildings, warehouses and storage facilities, hotels, restaurants, food-service businesses, retail outlets, supermarkets, schools, and universities. Commercial programs may include IPM protocols, rodent exclusion, cockroach management, anti-termite treatment, fumigation, fly management, fogging, and annual maintenance contracts.

Commercial page: https://superpest.in/commercial-pest-control/
